en.ServerNote: These settings belong to this server
en.Lead: Settings are kept on the server, for every device connected to it.
en.ProxyHelp: Starts with http://, https://, socks5:// or socks5h://, then a host name and a port, such as {address}. Leave it empty to connect directly. It applies from the next fetch. A subscription can follow this, connect directly, or use its own. AI summaries and translations do not use it.
en.ProxyAuthHelp: Only if the proxy asks for a user name and a password. Kept on the server and never shown again.
en.ProxyChanged: The saved sign-in is removed when you save a different address, unless you enter a new one here.
en.InvalidProxy: That is not a proxy address. Use http, https, socks5 or socks5h with a host name and a port, and no path or sign-in in it.
en.InvalidProxyAuth: The user name or password is too long.
en.ProxySaved: Proxy saved. It applies from the next fetch.
en.RSSHubHelp: Subscriptions added as an RSSHub route that starts with /, such as {route}, are fetched from these instances; subscriptions with a full web address are not affected. One address per line, at most 5; the first is the main instance. When it cannot be reached, times out or answers 5xx or 429, the next one is used as a fallback, and the main instance is used again once it recovers. Leave it empty if you have no route subscriptions; with it empty, route subscriptions fail to fetch.
en.Saved: Saved. The next fetch uses it.
en.RetentionSaved: Saved. Older entries are removed within the hour.
en.InvalidBase: Line {n} is not a full http or https address with a host name, such as https://rsshub.example.com.
en.InvalidBaseAny: An address is not a full http or https address with a host name, such as https://rsshub.example.com.
en.Unsaved: Some changes are not saved. Save them first; the back button leaves and drops them.
en.SaveFailed: Couldn’t save. Check the connection and try again.
en.RetentionHelp: Older entries are removed once an hour, read or not. Starred entries are always kept.
en.OPMLHelp: OPML files move subscriptions between Oriel and other readers.
en.ImportHelp: Adds the subscriptions in an OPML file. Ones you already have are skipped.
en.ExportHelp: Saves every subscription to one OPML file that Oriel and other readers can import.
en.Stopped: Stopped importing {file}: {added} added before it stopped, {existing} already subscribed.
en.Lost: Lost the connection while importing {file}. The server may still be adding subscriptions; check the list in a moment.
en.Imported: Imported {file}: {added} added, {existing} already subscribed, {failed} could not be added.
en.InvalidOPML: {file} is not an OPML file. Nothing was added.
en.DropHelp: Drop the OPML file here to add its subscriptions.
en.ImportedMany: Imported {n} files: {added} added, {existing} already subscribed, {failed} not added.
en.StoppedMany: Stopped during file {i} of {n}, the files after it were not imported: {added} added, {existing} already subscribed, {failed} not added.
en.LostMany: Lost the connection during file {i} of {n}, the files after it were not imported. The server may still be adding subscriptions; check the list in a moment. So far {added} added, {existing} already subscribed, {failed} not added.
en.DropBusy: Busy. Try again when the current import finishes.
en.ImportFailed: Couldn’t import {file}. Check the connection and try again.
en.ExportFailed: Couldn’t export. Check the connection and try again.
en.BackupHelp: Saves everything to one file: subscriptions, entries, what you have read and starred, AI results and settings. Sign-in sessions and the AI API key are left out.
en.RestoreHelp: Replaces what is here with the contents of a backup file. Back up first if you want to keep it.
en.BackupFailed: Couldn’t back up. Check the connection and try again.
en.RestoreNotBackup: {file} is not an Oriel backup. Nothing was changed.
en.RestoreNewer: {file} was made by a newer version of Oriel. Update Oriel first. Nothing was changed.
en.RestoreTooLarge: {file} is too large to restore. Nothing was changed.
en.RestoreBusy: Oriel is busy with another backup or restore. Try again in a moment.
en.RestoreFailed: Couldn’t restore {file}. Nothing was changed. Check the connection and try again.
en.RestoreTitle: Replace your data with this backup?
en.RestoreBody: The subscriptions, entries and settings here are replaced by the ones in {file}. This cannot be undone.
en.AutoHelp: Saves a backup to a folder on a schedule and removes older ones beyond the number to keep. Only files it wrote itself are removed.
en.AutoFailed: Last backup failed: {reason}. Trying again within the hour.
en.AutoRemote: The folder is on the server’s computer, and the path must exist there.
en.AutoReasonNotDir: the path is not a folder
en.AutoReasonNoWrite: the folder cannot be written to
en.AutoNeedFolder: Choose a folder first. It must be a full path.
en.AutoInvalidKeep: Keep a whole number from 1 to 100.
en.AutoSaveFailed: Couldn’t save. Check the connection and try again.
en.InvalidURL: Not an http or https address
en.DevicesHelp: Every sign-in is a device. Sign one out and it needs the password to connect again.
en.LocalDevices: This computer’s server has no password, so no device signs in to it. Devices show up here when you connect to a server that has one.
en.RevokeBody: It is signed out at once and needs the password to connect again.
en.RevokeFailed: Couldn’t sign out {name}. Check the connection and try again.
en.ErrorHint: The server didn’t answer. Check the connection and try again.
en.AILead: Summaries and translations go through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint of your choosing: OpenAI, another provider, or a model on this computer such as Ollama.
en.EndpointHelp: The base address of the API, such as {address}.
en.KeyHelp: Kept on the server and never shown again. A model on this computer may need none.
en.KeyReplace: Enter a new key to replace it
en.LanguageHelp: Summaries and translations are written in this language.
en.AIUnauthorized: The endpoint turned down the API key. Check the key.
en.AIUnreachable: Couldn’t reach the endpoint. Check the address, and that the server is running if it is on this computer.
en.AITimeout: The endpoint took too long to answer. A model that is still loading may need a moment: try again.
en.AIModelMissing: The endpoint has no model with that name, or the address is wrong. Check the model name, and that the address ends in /v1 if the service needs it.
en.AIRateLimited: The endpoint is taking too many requests. Try again in a moment.
en.AIUpstream: The endpoint answered with an error.
en.InvalidAIBase: Enter a full http or https address with a host name, such as https://api.openai.com/v1.
en.LimitsHelp: In characters. Lower them for a model with a small context window.
en.CapsHelp: Automatic summaries and translations share both caps. Your own requests are not counted or capped.
en.DestinationLocal: Entry text is sent to {address}, which is on this computer.
en.DestinationRemote: Entry text leaves this device for {address}, which is not on this computer.
en.CapReached: The daily cap of {limit} automatic requests is reached. Automatic summaries and translations stop until tomorrow; you can still ask for one yourself.
en.CheckListed: The model is in the endpoint’s list.
en.CheckFits: The model’s context is {n} tokens, enough for the limits.
en.CheckSmall: The model’s context is only {n} tokens, too small for the limits. Lower the summary limit and the chunk size.
en.InvalidLimit: Enter whole numbers of characters: 500 to 100000 for the summary limit, 500 to 20000 for the chunk size, 1 to 10000 for the daily cap, 1 to 100 for new entries per fetch. Leave a field empty for its default.
en.PromptHelp: {language} becomes the language above. Each subscription can use its own in Edit subscription.
en.InvalidPrompt: A prompt can be at most 4,000 characters.
en.AppearanceLead: These apply only to this device.
en.ThemeHelp: Light or dark. Teal stays the accent in both.
en.UIFontHelp: The text size follows your system’s text size.
en.ReadingFontHelp: The typeface of an article’s text.
en.TextSizeHelp: The text of an article in the reader.
en.LineSpacingHelp: The space between the lines of an article.
en.ChineseTypesettingHelp: Adds space between Chinese and Latin text and tightens runs of punctuation.
en.OpenAtLoginHelp: Opens Oriel after you sign in to the computer. While the menu bar icon is on, only the icon appears and no window opens.
en.OpenAtLoginHelpTray: Opens Oriel after you sign in to the computer. While the tray icon is on, only the icon appears and no window opens.
en.OpenAtLoginNeedsApp: Only the installed Oriel app can open at login.
en.MenuBarIconHelp: Shows the unread count in the menu bar. Oriel keeps updating in the background after the window is closed.
en.TrayIconHelp: Shows an icon in the tray. Oriel keeps updating in the background after the window is closed.
en.DockBadge: Unread badge on the Dock icon
en.DockBadgeHelp: Shows the unread count on the Dock icon.
en.TrayFailed: This system can’t show a tray icon. Install libayatana-appindicator3 and try again.
en.LineWidthHelp: How wide a line of text runs. Wide shows more per line, Narrow fewer.
en.ReadingAppearanceHelp: The paper and ink of the reader. Sepia and Mist follow Light and Dark.
en.ViewAsHelp: Grid and Wall are used in Videos and Images. Elsewhere those entries appear as rows or cards.
en.GroupSameLinkHelp: When several subscriptions carry the same article, the timeline shows one row.
en.DensityHelp: How tight the rows sit. Compact keeps everything and only tightens the spacing.
en.MarkReadHelpOpen: Opening an entry marks it as read.
en.MarkReadHelpDwell: An entry opened in the reader or the picture viewer is marked once you stay on it for the time below. Anything opened in the browser is marked at once.
en.MarkReadHelpScroll: Entries are marked as they scroll off the top of the list. Opening one does not mark it.
en.MarkReadHelpNever: Nothing is marked unless you do it: the read button, M, V or Mark all as read.
en.DwellHelp: How long an article stays open before it is marked.
en.PreviewText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. A good feed reader gets out of the way and lets the words do the work.
en.PreferenceFailed: Couldn’t save that choice. It went back to what it was.
en.ActivityLead: What is being fetched, how the recent fetches went, and the space the database uses.
en.CompactHelp: Rewrites the database file to give back unused space. It can take a while and runs in the background; Oriel stays usable, and new fetches wait until it is done. About {size} can be freed.
en.DeletePreMigrateTitle: Delete the copy made before the update?
en.DeletePreMigrateBody: It is a full copy of the database as it was before the last update, with sessions and API keys. Without it you cannot go back to the older version.
en.PreMigrateFailed: Could not delete the copy. Try again.
en.DiagnosticsHelp: Saves the version, the system, the recent errors, the end of the log and the host name and failures of each subscription as a text file. It has no password, keys, full addresses or article text, and it stays on this computer. The log itself is in the logs folder of the data directory, on the computer that runs the server.
en.DiagnosticsFailed: Couldn’t export. Check the connection and try again.
en.FetchingNone: Nothing is being fetched right now.
en.RecentNone: No fetches yet. Subscriptions appear here once they have been fetched.
en.HealthHelp: The latest {keep} requests at most, none older than {days} days. Counted again when the Oriel server restarts.
en.HealthEmpty: No data yet. The success rate and speed of each instance appear after an RSSHub subscription has been fetched.
en.CoolingSoon: Cooling down, trying again in under a minute
en.ReaderHelp: Brings subscriptions, starred entries and read state from Miniflux or FreshRSS.
en.ReaderMemory: Used for this import only. It is kept in memory and never saved.
en.ReaderFound: Found in {service}. Nothing has been added yet.
en.ReaderFoldersNote: Each becomes a folder. A subscription with several labels goes into the first.
en.ReaderResultUnmatched: {n} read {n:entry is|entries are} not in Oriel and {n:was|were} left out
en.ReaderResultDropped: {n} {n:subscription has|subscriptions have} more than one label; only the first was used
en.ReaderErrAddress: Not an http or https address.
en.ReaderErrUnauthorized: The server turned the credential down. Check the token, or the user name and password.
en.ReaderErrUnreachable: Couldn’t reach the server. Check the address.
en.ReaderErrRate: The server asked Oriel to slow down. Try again later.
en.ReaderErrBad: The server answered with something Oriel does not understand.
en.ReaderErrLarge: The server’s answer was too large.
en.ReaderErrRedirect: The server redirects to another address. Use the final address.
en.ReaderUnknownSource: Its subscription is not in Oriel
en.RulesLead: A rule stars or marks as read the entries that arrive after you set it. It runs once, when an entry first arrives, and never changes the entries you already have. Muted keywords work on every entry, at any time.
en.RulesNoneHelp: For example: star the new entries of one subscription whose title has “weekly” in it.
en.RuleWhenHelp: Everything you fill in has to match; several keywords match if any one does. Fill in at least one.
en.RuleKeywordsHelp: One per line. In the title or summary.
en.RuleExcludeHelp: One per line. Skipped when the title or summary has any of these. Not enough on its own.
en.RuleCount: {n} of your existing {n:entry matches|entries match} the conditions as they are now
en.RuleCountNone: None of your existing entries match the conditions as they are now
en.RuleAuthorHint: The author has this text in the name
en.RuleNote: Only entries that arrive from now on are affected. The entries you already have stay as they are.
en.ErrNoCondition: Fill in at least one condition.
en.ErrKeywords: At most 20 lines, up to 100 characters each.
en.ErrSource: This subscription was removed. Pick another.
en.ErrTooMany: There are already 50 rules. Delete one first.
en.MutedHelp: One per line. Entries whose title or summary has any of these are hidden from the timeline and the unread counts; starred entries stay. They work together with each subscription’s own muted keywords.
en.MutedInvalid: At most 200 lines, up to 100 characters each.
en.RulesErrorHint: The server did not answer. Check the connection and try again.

zh-Hans.ServerNote: 这些设置属于这个服务端
zh-Hans.Lead: 设置保存在服务端，连到它的每台设备都一样。
zh-Hans.ProxyHelp: 以 http://、https://、socks5:// 或 socks5h:// 开头，后面是主机名和端口，例如 {address}。留空就直接连接。从下一次抓取起生效。每个订阅可以跟随这里的设置、直接连接，或者用自己的代理。AI 摘要和翻译不走这个代理。
zh-Hans.ProxyAuthHelp: 代理要用户名和密码时才填。存在服务端，存好后不再显示。
zh-Hans.ProxyChanged: 保存另一个地址时，已存的登录信息会一并删除，除非你在这里填了新的。
zh-Hans.InvalidProxy: 这不是代理地址。用 http、https、socks5 或 socks5h，带主机名和端口，地址里不要有路径和登录信息。
zh-Hans.ProxySaved: 代理已保存，从下一次抓取起生效。
zh-Hans.RSSHubHelp: 以 / 开头的 RSSHub 路由订阅（例如 {route}）会用这里的实例抓取，完整网址的订阅不受影响。一行一个地址，最多 5 个，第一个是主实例。主实例连不上、超时或返回 5xx、429 时，会按顺序换用后面的备用地址，主实例恢复后自动换回。没有路由订阅就留空；留空时路由订阅会抓取失败。
zh-Hans.Saved: 已保存，下次抓取起生效。
zh-Hans.RetentionSaved: 已保存，过期的条目一小时内清理。
zh-Hans.InvalidBase: 第 {n} 行不是带主机名的完整 http 或 https 地址，例如 https://rsshub.example.com。
zh-Hans.InvalidBaseAny: 有一个地址不是带主机名的完整 http 或 https 地址，例如 https://rsshub.example.com。
zh-Hans.Unsaved: 有改动还没保存。先保存；用返回按钮离开会丢掉它们。
zh-Hans.SaveFailed: 没能保存。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.RetentionHelp: 过期的条目每小时清理一次，已读未读都删。收藏的条目一直保留。
zh-Hans.OPMLHelp: 用 OPML 文件在 Oriel 和别的阅读器之间搬订阅。
zh-Hans.ImportHelp: 添加 OPML 文件里的订阅，已经订阅的跳过。
zh-Hans.ExportHelp: 把所有订阅存成一个 OPML 文件，Oriel 和别的阅读器都能导入。
zh-Hans.ImportingOf: 正在导入 {file}（第 {i} 个，共 {n} 个文件）…
zh-Hans.Stopped: 导入 {file} 中途停了：停下前新增 {added} 个，{existing} 个已经订阅。
zh-Hans.Lost: 导入 {file} 时连接断了。服务端可能还在添加订阅，过一会儿再看列表。
zh-Hans.ImportBusy: 已经有一个导入在进行。
zh-Hans.BusyWhy: 已有另一个导入在进行
zh-Hans.Imported: 已导入 {file}：新增 {added} 个，{existing} 个已经订阅，{failed} 个没能添加。
zh-Hans.ImportedOk: 已导入 {file}：新增 {added} 个，{existing} 个已经订阅。
zh-Hans.InvalidOPML: {file} 不是 OPML 文件，什么都没有添加。
zh-Hans.DropHelp: 把 OPML 文件放到这里，添加它里面的订阅。
zh-Hans.ImportedMany: 已导入 {n} 个文件：新增 {added} 个，{existing} 个已经订阅，{failed} 个没能添加。
zh-Hans.StoppedMany: 导入在第 {i} 个文件（共 {n} 个）中途停了，之后的文件没有导入：新增 {added} 个，{existing} 个已经订阅，{failed} 个没能添加。
zh-Hans.LostMany: 导入第 {i} 个文件（共 {n} 个）时连接断了，之后的文件没有导入。服务端可能还在添加订阅，过一会儿再看列表。目前新增 {added} 个，{existing} 个已经订阅，{failed} 个没能添加。
zh-Hans.DropBusy: 正忙，请等当前的导入结束后再试。
zh-Hans.ImportFailed: 没能导入 {file}。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.Exported: 已把 {n} 个订阅导出到 {file}。
zh-Hans.ExportFailed: 没能导出。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.BackupHelp: 把全部内容存成一个文件：订阅、条目、已读和星标、AI 结果和设置。登录会话和 AI 的 API key 不在其中。
zh-Hans.RestoreHelp: 用备份文件里的内容替换现在的数据。想保留现在的数据，请先备份。
zh-Hans.BackupFailed: 没能备份。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.RestoreDone: 已恢复 {sources} 个订阅、{entries} 条条目。
zh-Hans.RestoreNotBackup: {file} 不是 Oriel 的备份，没有改动任何数据。
zh-Hans.RestoreCorrupt: {file} 已损坏，没有改动任何数据。
zh-Hans.RestoreNewer: {file} 来自更新版本的 Oriel。请先更新 Oriel，没有改动任何数据。
zh-Hans.RestoreTooLarge: {file} 太大，无法恢复，没有改动任何数据。
zh-Hans.RestoreBusy: Oriel 正在进行另一次备份或恢复，请稍后再试。
zh-Hans.RestoreFailed: 没能恢复 {file}，没有改动任何数据。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.RestoreTitle: 用这个备份替换现有数据？
zh-Hans.RestoreBody: 现在的订阅、条目和设置会被 {file} 里的替换，不能撤销。
zh-Hans.AutoHelp: 定期把备份存进一个文件夹，超出保留份数的旧备份会删掉。只删它自己写的文件。
zh-Hans.AutoFailed: 上次备份失败：{reason}。会在一小时内重试。
zh-Hans.AutoRemote: 文件夹在服务端那台电脑上，路径要在那台电脑上存在。
zh-Hans.AutoNeedFolder: 请先选一个文件夹，要写完整路径。
zh-Hans.AutoInvalidKeep: 保留份数要是 1 到 100 的整数。
zh-Hans.AutoSaveFailed: 没能保存。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.InvalidURL: 不是 http 或 https 地址
zh-Hans.DevicesHelp: 每次登录是一台设备。让它退出登录后，要重新输入口令才能连上。
zh-Hans.LocalDevices: 本机的服务端没有设口令，没有设备需要登录。连到设了口令的服务端后，登录过的设备会列在这里。
zh-Hans.RevokeBody: 它会立即退出登录，要重新输入口令才能连上。
zh-Hans.RevokeFailed: 没能让 {name} 退出登录。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.ErrorHint: 服务端没有响应。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.AILead: 摘要和翻译走你自己选的 OpenAI 兼容接口：OpenAI、别的服务商，或者本机的模型（例如 Ollama）。
zh-Hans.KeyHelp: 存在服务端，存好后不再显示。本机的模型可以不填。
zh-Hans.KeyReplace: 填新的 key 替换它
zh-Hans.LanguageHelp: 摘要和译文用这种语言写。
zh-Hans.Testing: 正在发一个很短的请求…
zh-Hans.AIUnauthorized: 接口不接受这个 API key。检查一下 key。
zh-Hans.AIUnreachable: 连不上接口。检查地址；服务在本机的话，确认它已启动。
zh-Hans.AITimeout: 接口太久没有响应。模型还在加载的话要等一会儿，稍后再试。
zh-Hans.AIModelMissing: 接口里没有这个名字的模型，或者地址不对。检查模型名，以及地址是否需要以 /v1 结尾。
zh-Hans.AIRateLimited: 接口的请求太多了，过一会儿再试。
zh-Hans.InvalidAIBase: 填带主机名的完整 http 或 https 地址，例如 https://api.openai.com/v1。
zh-Hans.LimitsHelp: 单位是字符。模型的上下文窗口小时，把它们调小。
zh-Hans.CapsHelp: 自动摘要和自动翻译共用这两个上限。你自己发起的请求不计数，也不受限。
zh-Hans.DestinationLocal: 文章内容会发送到 {address}，它在这台电脑上。
zh-Hans.DestinationRemote: 文章内容会离开这台设备，发送到 {address}，它不在这台电脑上。
zh-Hans.CapReached: 今天的 {limit} 次自动请求已用完，自动摘要和自动翻译到明天才继续；你仍可以自己发起。
zh-Hans.CheckFits: 模型的上下文有 {n} 个 token，够用。
zh-Hans.CheckSmall: 模型的上下文只有 {n} 个 token，放不下现在的限制。调小摘要上限和翻译分块。
zh-Hans.InvalidLimit: 摘要上限填 500 到 100000 的整数，翻译分块填 500 到 20000 的整数，单位是字符；每日自动请求上限填 1 到 10000，每次抓取的新文章数填 1 到 100；留空用默认值。
zh-Hans.PromptHelp: {language} 会换成上面的输出语言。每个订阅可以在「编辑订阅」里用自己的。
zh-Hans.AppearanceLead: 这些只对这台设备生效。
zh-Hans.ThemeHelp: 浅色或深色。两种主题下强调色都是青绿。
zh-Hans.UIFontHelp: 文字大小跟随系统的文字大小。
zh-Hans.TextSizeHelp: 阅读窗格里文章正文的大小。
zh-Hans.LineSpacingHelp: 文章正文的行与行之间的距离。
zh-Hans.ChineseTypesettingHelp: 中西文之间留出间隙，压缩连续标点。
zh-Hans.OpenAtLoginHelp: 登录电脑后自动打开 Oriel；菜单栏图标开着时只留图标，不弹窗口。
zh-Hans.OpenAtLoginHelpTray: 登录电脑后自动打开 Oriel；托盘图标开着时只留图标，不弹窗口。
zh-Hans.OpenAtLoginNeedsApp: 只有安装后的 Oriel 应用能登录时打开。
zh-Hans.MenuBarIconHelp: 在菜单栏显示未读数，关掉窗口后 Oriel 继续在后台更新。
zh-Hans.TrayIconHelp: 在托盘显示图标，关掉窗口后 Oriel 继续在后台更新。
zh-Hans.DockBadgeHelp: 在 Dock 图标上显示未读数。
zh-Hans.TrayFailed: 这个系统不支持托盘图标。安装 libayatana-appindicator3 后再试。
zh-Hans.LineWidthHelp: 一行文字有多宽。宽的一行字多，窄的一行字少。
zh-Hans.ReadingAppearanceHelp: 阅读窗格的纸色和字色。米黄和雾灰随浅色和深色主题变化。
zh-Hans.ViewAsHelp: 网格和瀑布流只在“视频”“图片”里使用；其他地方按列表或卡片显示。
zh-Hans.GroupSameLink: 同一篇文章只显示一次
zh-Hans.GroupSameLinkHelp: 几个订阅带同一篇文章时，时间线只显示一行。
zh-Hans.DensityHelp: 行与行之间的松紧。紧凑不删任何内容，只收紧间距。
zh-Hans.MarkReadHelpDwell: 在阅读器或看图层里打开的条目，停留满下面的时间才标为已读；在浏览器里打开的立即标为已读。
zh-Hans.MarkReadHelpScroll: 条目滚出列表顶部时标为已读，打开它不标。
zh-Hans.MarkReadHelpNever: 不自动标，只有你自己标才算：已读按钮、M、V 或「全部标为已读」。
zh-Hans.DwellHelp: 文章打开多久后标为已读。
zh-Hans.PreviewText: 好的阅读器不抢戏，让文字自己说话。订阅了 50 个 RSS 源，每天读 Go 和 SQLite 的文章，字号和行距合不合适，眼睛最先知道（见「阅读」）。
zh-Hans.PreferenceFailed: 没能保存这项选择，已退回原来的值。
zh-Hans.ActivityLead: 现在在抓什么、最近抓得怎么样，以及数据库占用的空间。
zh-Hans.CompactHelp: 重写数据库文件，把空闲的空间还给系统。可能要一会儿，在后台进行，Oriel 照常可用；压缩期间不开始新的抓取。大约能腾出 {size}。
zh-Hans.DeletePreMigrateBody: 它是上次更新前数据库的完整副本，里面有会话和 API key。删除后就不能用它退回旧版本了。
zh-Hans.PreMigrateFailed: 没能删除副本，请再试一次。
zh-Hans.DiagnosticsHelp: 把版本、系统、最近的错误、日志的最后一段，以及每个订阅的主机名和失败情况存成一个文本文件。里面没有口令、密钥、完整网址和文章内容，只存在这台电脑上。日志文件本身在运行服务端的那台电脑的数据目录的 logs 文件夹里。
zh-Hans.DiagnosticsFailed: 没能导出。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.FetchingNone: 现在没有在抓取的订阅。
zh-Hans.RecentNone: 还没有抓取记录。订阅抓取过之后会出现在这里。
zh-Hans.RecentKeep: 每个订阅保留最近 {n} 次。
zh-Hans.HealthHelp: 最近最多 {keep} 次请求，不超过 {days} 天。Oriel 服务端重启后重新计算。
zh-Hans.HealthEmpty: 还没有数据。抓取过 RSSHub 订阅后显示各实例的成功率和延迟。
zh-Hans.Cooling: 冷却中，约 {n} 分钟后再试
zh-Hans.CoolingSoon: 冷却中，不到 1 分钟后再试
zh-Hans.ReaderHelp: 从 Miniflux 或 FreshRSS 取来订阅、加星标的条目和已读状态。
zh-Hans.ReaderMemory: 只用于这次导入，只放在内存里，不会保存。
zh-Hans.ReaderStageStarred: 正在读取加星标的条目…
zh-Hans.ReaderFound: 在 {service} 里找到了这些，还没有添加任何内容。
zh-Hans.ReaderFoldersNote: 每个都会成为一个文件夹。订阅有多个标签时，放进第一个。
zh-Hans.ReaderResultSources: 新增 {added} 个订阅，{existing} 个已经订阅
zh-Hans.ReaderResultStarred: 新增 {added} 条加星标的条目，{existing} 条已经有了
zh-Hans.ReaderResultUnmatched: {n} 条已读的条目不在 Oriel 里，没有导入
zh-Hans.ReaderResultDropped: {n} 个订阅有多个标签，只用了第一个
zh-Hans.ReaderErrAddress: 不是 http 或 https 地址。
zh-Hans.ReaderErrUnauthorized: 服务器不认这个凭据。检查令牌，或者用户名和密码。
zh-Hans.ReaderErrUnreachable: 连不上服务器。检查地址。
zh-Hans.ReaderErrRate: 服务器要求慢一点。请稍后再试。
zh-Hans.ReaderErrBad: 服务器的回应 Oriel 看不懂。
zh-Hans.ReaderErrRedirect: 服务器会跳转到别的地址。请用最终的地址。
zh-Hans.ReaderErrBusy: 已经有一个导入在进行。
zh-Hans.ReaderUnknownSource: 它的订阅不在 Oriel 里
zh-Hans.RulesLead: 规则让设置之后到来的条目自动加星标或标为已读。它只在条目第一次到来时执行一次，不会改已有的条目。屏蔽词则对所有条目随时生效。
zh-Hans.RulesNoneHelp: 例如：把某个订阅里标题含“周报”的新条目自动加星标。
zh-Hans.RuleWhen: 满足以下条件的新条目
zh-Hans.RuleWhenHelp: 填了的条件都要满足；关键词写多个时，命中任何一个即可。至少填一个。
zh-Hans.RuleKeywordsHelp: 一行一个，在标题或摘要里找。
zh-Hans.RuleExcludeHelp: 一行一个。标题或摘要里有其中任何一个就跳过。只填这一项不算条件。
zh-Hans.RuleCount: 按现在的条件，已有条目里有 {n} 条会命中
zh-Hans.RuleCountNone: 按现在的条件，已有条目里没有会命中的
zh-Hans.RuleNote: 只对之后到来的新条目生效，已有的条目不变。
zh-Hans.ErrKeywords: 最多 20 行，每行最多 100 个字符。
zh-Hans.ErrSource: 这个订阅已经删除了，重新选一个。
zh-Hans.ErrTooMany: 已经有 50 条规则了，先删掉一条。
zh-Hans.MutedHelp: 一行一个。标题或摘要里有这些词的条目会从时间线和未读数里隐藏；收藏的不隐藏。和各订阅自己的屏蔽词一起生效。
zh-Hans.MutedInvalid: 最多 200 行，每行最多 100 个字符。
zh-Hans.RulesErrorHint: 服务端没有响应。检查一下连接再试。
